blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein \(f\) ka koi formula nahi diya, is liye integral ki value nahi nikal sakte; sirf properties se expression ko chhota kar sakte hain.
Diya kya hai? Chaar integrals, kuch ki limits ulti hain.
Find kya karna hai? Sab ko mila kar sab se saada shakal.
Rule kaunsa? Property II se ulti limits ko seedha karenge (sign badal ke), phir Property III se saath wale intervals jorenge.
Plan: limits seedhi, group banana, jorna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(E = \int_{0}^{1} f - \int_{0}^{2} f - \int_{3}^{1} f + \int_{3}^{2} f\) (sab mein \(dx\)).
Maloom karna: \(E\) ki sab se saada shakal.
Tareeqa: Property II \(\int_a^b f = -\int_b^a f\) aur Property III \(\int_a^c f + \int_c^b f = \int_a^b f\). Jab function maloom na ho to yahi do properties kaam aati hain.

Limits seedhi karein
\[-\int_{3}^{1} f(x)\,dx = \int_{1}^{3} f(x)\,dx\]
\[\int_{3}^{2} f(x)\,dx = -\int_{2}^{3} f(x)\,dx\]
Kyun: Property II: limits ulat do to sign ulat jata hai. Pehle wale mein minus pehle se tha, to minus aur minus mil kar plus bana.
Dhyan dein: sign badalna bhool kar sirf limits ulat dena sab se aam ghalti hai.

Groups banayein
\[E = \left(\int_{0}^{1} f + \int_{1}^{3} f\right) - \left(\int_{0}^{2} f + \int_{2}^{3} f\right)\]
Kyun: plus wale ek taraf aur minus wale doosri taraf; har group mein intervals aapas mein jurte hain.

Intervals jorein
\[E = \int_{0}^{3} f(x)\,dx - \int_{0}^{3} f(x)\,dx = 0\]
Kyun: Property III: \([0, 1]\) aur \([1, 3]\) mil kar \([0, 3]\), aur \([0, 2]\) aur \([2, 3]\) bhi mil kar \([0, 3]\). Ek hi cheez ko minus kiya to zero.

Tasdeeq: \(f(x) = 1\) le kar
\[1 - 2 - (-2) + (-1) = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(f = 1\) ho to har integral bas (upar wali limit minus neeche wali) hota hai. Kisi bhi function ke liye jawab 0 hona chahiye, to is aasaan function ke liye bhi; aur aaya. Answer key mein bhi 0 hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan bhi \(f\) ka formula nahi, sirf properties se simplify karna hai.
Diya kya hai? Chaar integrals; do mein \(f(4 - x)\) aur \(f(5 - x)\) hain.
Find kya karna hai? Sab ki saada shakal.
Rule kaunsa? Pehle Property IV se \(f(4 - x)\) aur \(f(5 - x)\) ko \(f(x)\) banayenge (kyunke un ki limits ka jama 4 aur 5 hai). Phir constants bahar, aur Property III se intervals jorenge.
Plan: Property IV, rewrite, jorna, terms ikatthi karna. Har sign bilkul chhape hue sawal ke mutabiq rakhna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(E = 5\int_{0}^{3} f(x)\,dx - 5\int_{1}^{3} f(4 - x)\,dx - 5\int_{1}^{5} f(x)\,dx - 4\int_{0}^{5} f(5 - x)\,dx\).
Maloom karna: \(E\) ki saada shakal.
Tareeqa: Property IX (constant bahar), Property IV \(\int_a^b f(a + b - x)\,dx = \int_a^b f(x)\,dx\), aur Property III.

\(f(4 - x)\) aur \(f(5 - x)\) hatayein
\[\int_{1}^{3} f(4 - x)\,dx = \int_{1}^{3} f(x)\,dx\]
\[\int_{0}^{5} f(5 - x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{5} f(x)\,dx\]
Kyun: Property IV: pehle mein \(a + b = 1 + 3 = 4\), doosre mein \(0 + 5 = 5\). Yani \(4 - x\) aur \(5 - x\) bilkul \(a + b - x\) hain, is liye integral \(f(x)\) wala hi ban jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Property IV tabhi lagti hai jab andar wala number limits ke jama ke barabar ho; pehle yeh check karein.

\(E\) dobara likhein
\[E = 5\int_{0}^{3} f - 5\int_{1}^{3} f - 5\int_{1}^{5} f - 4\int_{0}^{5} f\]
Kyun: dono nateeje rakh diye; ab har integral \(f(x)\,dx\) ka hai.

Pehle do ko jorein
\[5\int_{0}^{3} f - 5\int_{1}^{3} f = 5\int_{0}^{1} f\]
Kyun: Property III: \(\int_0^3 f = \int_0^1 f + \int_1^3 f\), to \(\int_1^3\) wala hissa cancel ho kar \(\int_0^1\) bachta hai.

Aakhri ko torein aur ikattha karein
\[4\int_{0}^{5} f = 4\int_{0}^{1} f + 4\int_{1}^{5} f\]
\[E = 5\int_{0}^{1} f - 5\int_{1}^{5} f - 4\int_{0}^{1} f - 4\int_{1}^{5} f\]
\[E = \int_{0}^{1} f(x)\,dx - 9\int_{1}^{5} f(x)\,dx\]
Kyun: Property III se \([0, 5]\) ko \([0, 1]\) aur \([1, 5]\) mein tora, phir ek jaise integrals ke coefficients jama kiye: \(5 - 4 = 1\) aur \(-5 - 4 = -9\). In do intervals ko ab mazeed jora nahi ja sakta, kyunke coefficients mukhtalif hain.

Tasdeeq: \(f(x) = 1\) le kar
\[5(3) - 5(2) - 5(4) - 4(5) = -35\]
\[1 - 9(4) = -35 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(f = 1\) ho to har integral apne interval ki lambai ke barabar hai. Asal expression aur hamari saada shakal dono \(-35\) deti hain, to simplification sahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(\int_{0}^{5} f(x)\,dx\) chhapa hai. Yeh jawab tab aata hai jab teesra integral jama ho (\(+\int_{1}^{5} 5f(x)\,dx\)): phir \(E = 5\int_0^1 f + 5\int_1^5 f - 4\int_0^5 f = \int_0^5 f\). Lekin sawal mein jo signs chhape hain un ke saath sahi jawab \(\int_{0}^{1} f(x)\,dx - 9\int_{1}^{5} f(x)\,dx\) hai (\(f = 1\) rakh kar dekhein: \(-35\) aata hai, 5 nahi). Ya to key ghalat hai ya teesre integral se pehle minus ka sign.
